products.title: Luma Smart Litter Box
products.body_html:
· 24/7 odor control: The built-in fan actively circulates air through a carbon deodorizer to trap 97% of litter box odors.*
· Auto scooping, always clean: Luma scoops after every use to keep the litter box consistently clean and holds up to 7 days of waste for 2 cats. The removable litter basket makes cleanup a snap.**
· Four safety checks for more peace of mind: Weight, visual, and infrared motion sensors work together with anti-pinch protection to confirm your cat is clear before cleaning. If a cat is detected, Luma pauses instantly.
· Multi-cat recognition: Designed for multi-cat homes, Luma can identify up to 10 cats from multiple angles, even from behind, so each visit is accurately tracked.
· AI waste analysis: Luma records and analyzes your cat’s #1 and #2 to help you notice changes early and stay informed about their health.***
· Live view & playback: Check in anytime with live streaming, or review recorded litter box visits. Each session is captured for up to 10 minutes for added visibility and peace of mind.***
· Smart alerts & notifications: Stay informed without checking manually. Get alerts for low litter levels, camera lens obstruction, and unusual behavior—like no litter box activity for 24 hours—so you can act when it matters.

*Based on a 6-hour test by a third-party lab. Actual results may vary depending on environment and usage.
**Based on internal testing with 2 cats. Actual waste storage duration may vary depending on usage and litter type.
***Live streaming is available without subscription. AI analysis, event recording, and historical playback require a Video Cloud AI subscription. SD cards are not supported.
